description: the mlops-engineer role exists as an agent definition — the LLMOps counterpart to the finops-analyst, scoped to the gateway
SEPARATION OF DUTIES: the mlops-engineer has no Edit/Write tool — the role that DIAGNOSES a route flip cannot APPLY the revert; a change-reviewer approves
command: scripts/role-authority-check.sh mlops-engineer write >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 3 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: MODEL RIGHT-SIZING: the mlops-engineer runs at sonnet, not opus — a bounded config+trace read does not need the strongest reasoner (M4/M9 lesson in LLMOps)
the two-layer cost receipt exists and is executable — it prices the workload AND the review, the M11 agent-cost-receipt pattern applied to LLMOps
WORKLOAD COST: on the regressed deep route the receipt prices the support workload at the high per-day figure the incident is about (> $1000/day)
command: [ "$(scripts/gateway-cost-receipt.sh --field workload_day | cut -d. -f1)" -gt 1000 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: REVIEW COST: pricing the review at the role's model (sonnet) is cheaper than all-opus — the receipt PROVES right-sizing the reviewer saves money
command: S=$(scripts/gateway-cost-receipt.sh --field review_sonnet); O=$(scripts/gateway-cost-receipt.sh --field review_opus); awk -v s="$S" -v o="$O" 'BEGIN{exit !(s<o)}' && echo pass || echo fail

description: RATE-LIMIT FAILURE MODE: the deep route's configured 300k tpm exceeds the provider's 120k deep ceiling — negative headroom is a throttling incident the flip introduced silently
command: H=$(scripts/llm-dials.sh dials support --field tpm_headroom | cut -d. -f1); [ "$H" -lt 0 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: MLOPS vs LLMOPS: the routing artifact carries LLMOps signals (route->model, rate_limit tpm) — routing/cost/quality of hosted models, NOT training/serving of an in-house model
command: yq -e '.routes.support.rate_limit.tpm' platform/gateway/routing.yaml >/dev/null 2>&1 && yq -e '.routes.support.model' platform/gateway/routing.yaml >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail

description: QUALITY DIAL: after the gate runs, llm-dials reports the recorded gate verdict as the quality dial — the four dials read together, quality is measured not invented
command: scripts/promptfoo-gate.sh evals/promptfoo/support-summarize.yaml --set good --field verdict >/dev/null 2>&1; V=$(scripts/llm-dials.sh dials support | jq -r '.quality.last_gate_verdict'); [ "$V" = pass ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: REGRESSION AS A GATE: the regressed output set trips required assertions (dropped ID, invented refund, guaranteed date) and the gate exits non-zero — quality drift is blocked before prod
command: if scripts/promptfoo-gate.sh evals/promptfoo/support-summarize.yaml --set regressed >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo fail; else echo pass; fi
